entries.averment: Neglect or refusal to maintain is pleaded expressly (the statutory trigger).
The petitioner files an affidavit of assets and liabilities.
A divorced-wife petitioner avers that she has not remarried.
For a child claimant aged 18 or over, an inability to maintain themselves due to a physical or mental abnormality is pleaded.

source.ref: proviso to s.125(1) CrPC / s.144 BNSS

entries.averment: A positive quantum of maintenance is sought, with a stated computation basis (not a bare figure).
